## Change

What problem does this solve, and what changes for the user?

## Related issue

Link an issue if applicable. Use `Closes #...` only when the change fully resolves it.

## Validation

Describe checks run, results, and any checks not run. Include screenshots for UI changes.

## Compatibility

Mention configuration changes, migrations, effects on stored media, and any rollback considerations. Write “None” if not applicable.
